title: Check your own biases
objectives: Name three distributor biases and the guard question for recency.
Apply the guard question before every recommendation.
body_md:
Distributors are not immune. Watch for: recommending last year's best performer to every client (recency); favouring products you are most comfortable explaining (familiarity); agreeing with a client's view to avoid an awkward conversation (confirmation, people-pleasing). A simple guard: before every recommendation, ask “Would I suggest this if it hadn't done well last year?”

> **Investor takeaway:** Knowing which bias you're most prone to helps you avoid it.
example: A manager asks you to pitch last year's top fund to every client: recognise your own recency bias, raise suitability, use the checklist.
say: Would I suggest this if it hadn't done well last year?
Distributors are not immune to biases.
never: Agree with the client to avoid awkwardness.
